title: Planned maintenance: NBN services connected to the Lonsdale Depot POI (Adelaide, SA)
current_summary: The planned maintenance on the nbn Point of Interconnect (POI) at Lonsdale Depot in South Australia has been completed. nbn services connected through this POI should now be operating normally. Customers connected through other POIs were not expected to be affected.

cause.reason: Planned service restoration activities on the backhaul connection to this nbn Point of Interconnect, carried out by a network provider.

updates.content: We have been advised that our network provider will carry out some service restoration activities on the backhaul connection to the nbn Point of Interconnect (POI) at Lonsdale Depot in South Australia. The work is scheduled between 11:00 pm on Wednesday 28 October and 6:00 am on Thursday 29 October 2026 (ACDT). nbn services connected through this POI may be affected for up to 7 hours during that window. We will share further updates if anything changes.

The scheduled maintenance on the nbn Point of Interconnect at Lonsdale Depot has now started. nbn services connected through this POI may be interrupted until the window ends at 6:00 am on Thursday 29 October 2026 (ACDT). We will update you if anything changes.

The scheduled maintenance on the nbn Point of Interconnect at Lonsdale Depot has been completed as of 6:30 am on Thursday 29 October 2026 (ACDT). nbn services connected through this POI should now be back to normal. If you are still experiencing problems, please restart your modem and contact our support team if the issue continues.
